plan.objective: Audit Digital Risk for 2026-01-01 through 2026-08-31. Test all applicable controls and follow approved findings through independent remediation.
plan.work_program: Test full population of all controls using original evidence sources for the period 2026-01-01 to 2026-08-31. Authorize 90-day follow-up verification for independent remediation of any approved findings.

message.content: Plan proposed (pending human approval). All work items remain ready for execution post-approval.

finding.title: EDR coverage not enabled on one device
finding.wording: On the last active day in scope, device DEV-003 did not have EDR coverage enabled as required by policy POL-ENDPOINT.v1.
finding.rationale: Test result 89f7170b-022c-4162-b113-0c7c3274be4a shows requirement_not_met for covered=false on DEV-003.
finding.recommendation: Enable EDR on all in-scope devices and verify coverage status as of last active day.

finding.title: Vulnerability scan outdated on one device
finding.wording: Device DEV-004 vulnerability scan dated 2026-07-01 exceeds the 30-day window before period end 2026-08-31 as required by policy POL-VULN.v1.
finding.rationale: Test result a0db5d41-28a4-4501-b161-786bc761646b shows requirement_not_met for scan timeliness.
finding.recommendation: Ensure all devices receive vulnerability scans within 30 days of period end and remediate any gaps.

controls.title: EDR coverage active
controls.requirement: EDR covered is true on the last active day in scope.
controls.policy_text: On each device's last active day within the audit period, EDR coverage and disk encryption must be enabled. Its vulnerability scan must be no more than 30 calendar days old. Evidence must describe that in-scope date.

controls.title: Vulnerability scanning current
controls.requirement: 0 <= last active day in scope - scanned_on <= 30 days.
controls.policy_text: On each device's last active day within the audit period, EDR coverage and disk encryption must be enabled. Its vulnerability scan must be no more than 30 calendar days old. Evidence must describe that in-scope date.

controls.title: Disk encryption enabled
controls.requirement: Encryption enabled is true on the last active day in scope.
controls.policy_text: On each device's last active day within the audit period, EDR coverage and disk encryption must be enabled. Its vulnerability scan must be no more than 30 calendar days old. Evidence must describe that in-scope date.

controls.title: Owner remains employed
controls.requirement: employment_end is null or later than the last active day in scope.
controls.policy_text: On each account's last active day within the audit period, its owner must still be employed, MFA must be enabled, and an access review must be no more than 90 calendar days old. Employment end is the first day the owner is no longer employed.

controls.title: Privileged MFA enabled
controls.requirement: MFA enabled is true on the last active day in scope.
controls.policy_text: On each account's last active day within the audit period, its owner must still be employed, MFA must be enabled, and an access review must be no more than 90 calendar days old. Employment end is the first day the owner is no longer employed.

controls.title: Access review current
controls.requirement: 0 <= last active day in scope - reviewed_on <= 90 days.
controls.policy_text: On each account's last active day within the audit period, its owner must still be employed, MFA must be enabled, and an access review must be no more than 90 calendar days old. Employment end is the first day the owner is no longer employed.

controls.title: Risk assessment before deployment
controls.requirement: A risk assessment exists and assessed_on <= deployed_on.
controls.policy_text: Every deployed project must have a risk assessment and documented approval dated on or before deployment. The GRC approval date must agree with original approval history. A GRC claim alone is not approval evidence.

controls.title: Approval before deployment
controls.requirement: Original approval history exists and approved_on <= deployed_on.
controls.policy_text: Every deployed project must have a risk assessment and documented approval dated on or before deployment. The GRC approval date must agree with original approval history. A GRC claim alone is not approval evidence.

controls.title: GRC approval agrees with source
controls.requirement: GRC and original approval dates are equal. Investigate mismatches before proposing a finding.
controls.policy_text: Every deployed project must have a risk assessment and documented approval dated on or before deployment. The GRC approval date must agree with original approval history. A GRC claim alone is not approval evidence.
